description: Where playback starts: the saved spot when it is over 10 s, before the last 8 % of the item (any spot when the length is unknown) and the item is not watched.

cases.name: a spot in the middle resumes
10 s or less starts from the beginning
no saved spot starts from the beginning
a watched item starts from the beginning
in the last 8 % (the credits) starts from the beginning
unknown length resumes any spot over 10 s
a zero length counts as unknown
